name: libphonenumber-ae/phonenumber
description: Validate and format international phone numbers. A thin ext-ffi binding over the shared libphonenumber native engine — no phone-number logic lives in PHP.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the v6 47-check binding conformance suite (no dependencies required).

suggest.ext-ffi: Required at run time; the engine is loaded with FFI::cdef.
